meta.title: Tab Status Light
meta.description: Recolors the DSH whale on the browser tab by session state — only the glyph's fill changes, never the tab background: assistant-event violet while generating, amber while a question or approval waits for you, green after output finishes in the background. Concurrent states split the whale into left-to-right color bands (reply / running / done); the original white/black icon only appears when no state is active.
